name: architectural-render-guard
description: Keyless architectural generation and editing through Codex built-in image generation with building preservation review.

interface.shortDescription: Render buildings with Codex built-in images.
interface.longDescription: Generate or edit architectural images using Codex built-in image generation without API keys or Gemini. Prepare guarded prompts, check actual aspect ratio, and visually inspect building preservation.
defaultPrompt: Use Architectural Render Guard to generate an architectural image with Codex built-in image generation.
Edit this building image while preserving its massing, floors, openings, stairs, ramp and signage.
Use these reference images for materials and environment while preserving the primary building.
